SIGNALS.name: Reuters
SIGNALS.summary: Reuters reports the UK government has set out about $800 million of funding for AI security.

SIGNALS.name: The Transcript
SIGNALS.summary: Quotes Amazon CEO Andy Jassy saying AWS capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with much of 2028 already committed, citing limits on data center space, power and memory.

SIGNALS.name: ClaudeDevs
SIGNALS.summary: Claude adds support for MCP Tasks, letting plugins run long jobs like deep research and report back, and Elicitations, which let plugins ask users for input mid-task. Live in Claude Code CLI first.

SIGNALS.name: Kimi.ai
SIGNALS.summary: Moonshot introduces Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open-weight multimodal MoE model with 2.8T total and 104B active parameters, a 1M-token context, and upgrades for coding and 3D work.

SIGNALS.name: Block
SIGNALS.summary: Block introduced Dessa, a speech model it says was trained from scratch on human conversation, and shared a link where people can hear it.

SIGNALS.name: Anthropic
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team blog describes using Claude to formally verify software at large scale, aiming to prove code free of certain bugs without heavy expert time.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Claude says that starting next week its web, desktop and mobile sessions will default to auto mode on Pro, Max and Team plans, with an automated check blocking risky actions.

SIGNALS.name: ClaudeDevs
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic is donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation, home of MCP, noting 70+ agent platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and VS Code have adopted the standard.

SIGNALS.name: The Rundown AI
SIGNALS.summary: Reports that ex-OpenAI product chief Kevin Weil raised $215M for Warp Sciences, which builds labs where AI designs experiments and robots run them, starting with drug discovery.
